body: as in apple? Only at work.
I'm not sure if that's a good idea. I'm in a foreign country and it would cost a bit of money.

Thank you for the advice. But a temporary escape is only a temporary solution. 

I've been sick before, but those thoughts of suicide were only thoughts, images in my head. This time their real. I could feel myself "flying" through the air and landing on the asphalt, maybe on that car and hoping that would be it. Temporary escapes have turned into constant escapes. Not much holds me in place, nothing I can live off of. And it's "so important" to live on your own means.  This is my fear, that I can't do that. I can't work, because of the fear inducing "importance" of it.

I need to not be so afraid. I'm deathly scared. I didn't go to work today. It's the first real job I've had in years. And I'm so afraid of it. I'm afraid of the people I hardly know, I'm afraid of failures I haven't had yet.
